svg.title: Edit distance: where D[i][j] comes from
svg.text: Here A[1] = ‘o’ equals B[1] = ‘o’, so D[2][2] copies the diagonal: 1.
The answer is the bottom-right cell: 3.
Edit distance: where D[i][j] comes from
D[i][j] = edits to turn the first i letters of “horse” into the first j of “ros”. Each cell looks at three
